purpose: Attribute the selected SXS-row tolerance drift to fine-stage output sampling without changing the accepted coarse or fine ODE trajectories. This is a numerical diagnostic, not a release prescription.
checks: Replay the exact prior default time and mode hashes at (atol,rtol)=(1e-15,1e-14), dt=0.25 M. Change only the fine-stage output resampler from the production-path default to one Fehlberg substep from each preceding accepted state. Require identical accepted coarse and fine time, state, derivative, and valid arrays; compare complete complex modes directly without alignment. Report the difference against the prior tighter-to-tightest 1.287014271635021e-5 drift and the frozen 1e-6 budget.
